text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are women, meaning sex was not a barrier to being hired. An all-female panel selecting a female candidate offers no credible basis for a sex discrimination claim, and raising the panel’s composition will appear unfounded and harm your professional reputation.

For director-level roles, municipalities frequently weigh public consultation, political acumen, and stakeholder relations more heavily than technical planning degrees or licenses. The decision likely hinged on interview performance and executive fit. 

Rather than mentioning gender, send a professional follow-up reiterating your request for constructive feedback focused on what competencies or interview areas you can develop for future leadership opportunities.
